description: Phase 3 method contribution: amortised per-subject adapter init theta_s = H(c_s). H is an AdapterHypernetwork emitting (A,B) factors per layer from a 2*n_channels context descriptor (per-channel log-variance + log-covariance eigenvalues), trained by regression onto the trained per-subject adapters of a baseline model. Held-out init is a single forward pass H(c_heldout) using unlabelled calibration+test trials for the context. Runner: run_experiment.py --condition hypernet.
note: This is the performance-oriented arm: replaces the single Reptile centroid with a per-subject predicted init, targeting outlier subjects (S7 on 2a, S8 on 2b) that the centroid harms. Distilled targets (distill.py) are an optional gated upgrade to the regression targets.
